templates.template: CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2
templates.name: CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2
templates.description: Import and link explicitly. Requires Agent 2 systemd plugin. Monitoring macro defaults to0 until the timer and problem/recovery path are verified. Status is public; never grant the agent access to private state.

parameters: var value = JSON.parse(value)["initialized"]; return value === true ? 1 : (value === false || value === null ? 0 : value);
var value = JSON.parse(value)["last_success"]; return value === true ? 1 : (value === false || value === null ? 0 : value);
var value = JSON.parse(value)["approval_required"]; return value === true ? 1 : (value === false || value === null ? 0 : value);
var value = JSON.parse(value)["recovery_failed"]; return value === true ? 1 : (value === false || value === null ? 0 : value);

macros.description: Set1 only after timer and notification validation.
Maximum age of successful sync in seconds.

triggers.expression: {$CFSYNC.MONITORING.ENABLED}=1 and (last(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/systemd.unit.info[cloudfront-sync.service,ActiveState])="failed")
triggers.name: CloudFront synchronization unit failed

triggers.expression: {$CFSYNC.MONITORING.ENABLED}=1 and (last(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/cloudfront.sync.initialized)=1 and (now()-last(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/cloudfront.sync.last_success))>{$CFSYNC.MAX.SUCCESS.AGE})
triggers.name: CloudFront synchronization has not succeeded recently

triggers.expression: {$CFSYNC.MONITORING.ENABLED}=1 and (nodata(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/vfs.file.contents[/var/lib/cloudfront-sync/status.json],5m)=1)
triggers.name: CloudFront synchronization status is unavailable

triggers.expression: {$CFSYNC.MONITORING.ENABLED}=1 and (last(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/cloudfront.sync.approval_required)=1)
triggers.name: CloudFront range change awaits approval

triggers.expression: {$CFSYNC.MONITORING.ENABLED}=1 and (last(/CloudFront range sync by Zabbix agent 2/cloudfront.sync.recovery_failed)=1)
triggers.name: CloudFront synchronization recovery failed
